summary.text: Tim Carpenter is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 3 since 2003 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He earlier served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, from 1983 to 2001.

paragraphs.text: Tim Carpenter graduated from Pulaski High School, received a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee and earned a master's degree from the La Follette Institute at the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
His career experience includes working for Rustlers Steak House and Federal Express.
In the 2025-2026 session, Carpenter was assigned to the Transportation and Local Government Committee.
